title: Power Apps: consolidated AI settings for model-driven apps in Copilot hub and Maker Studio
summary: Hold: the table incorrectly reports environment-setting automation as undocumented, and some navigation instructions do not reach the stated control. The briefing also treats access to Copilot settings as proof of permission to edit them and tells administrators to use legacy switches it elsewhere says have been removed.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented automation for the environment's form fill assistance settings.
claims.quote:
| powerApps\_FormPredictAutomatic | boolean |  |
| powerApps\_FormPredictSmartPaste | boolean |  |
claims.fix: Remove the first table row rather than reporting its automation as Not yet documented; retain its existing UI description in the notes. The EnvironmentManagementSetting schema documents powerApps_FormPredictAutomatic and powerApps_FormPredictSmartPaste, and https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform/environmentmanagement/environment-management-settings/update-environment-management-settings documents PATCH /environmentmanagement/environments/{environmentId}/settings?api-version=2024-10-01 for updating its fields.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls: legacy paths
claims.claim: Environment > Settings > Product > Features is the navigable admin-centre route for inspecting the legacy switches.
claims.quote:
In the navigation pane, select Manage.
In the Manage pane, select Environments.
On the Environments page, select an environment.
In the command bar, select Settings.
Expand Product, and then select Features.
claims.fix: For actionable legacy-switch instructions, use 'Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features' in the Power Platform admin center. Keep 'Environment > Settings' only where quoting the roadmap or Learn's shorthand description of the move.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout, edit-access bullet
claims.claim: The tenant admin or environment admin role can edit these Power Apps Copilot settings.

claims.fix: Replace the bullet with 'Confirm who can edit these settings before delegating, and check that nobody else needs edit access.' Retain the separately supported statements that tenant and environment admins can access the Copilot area and tenant users with environment access can view settings.
